subject.title: fix(doctor): stop advisory state-dir skips from wedging gateway startup

question: Does OpenClaw intend a pre-existing canonical state directory to make every unresolved legacy-directory shape advisory rather than startup-blocking?
rationale: The proposed change alters a deliberate fail-closed upgrade boundary; repository inspection is required to confirm all runtime readers use the canonical path and that no state can remain active under the legacy path.

options.title: Confirm advisory classification
options.body: Treat skipped legacy paths as notices whenever the canonical directory exists, after confirming canonical-path ownership across runtime reads.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Continue blocking readiness for all unresolved legacy state paths until an explicit repair/migration design is chosen.

recommendation.title: Confirm advisory classification
recommendation.body: Treat skipped legacy paths as notices whenever the canonical directory exists, after confirming canonical-path ownership across runtime reads.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied related-PR context identifies this person as the author of the startup-checkpoint behavior whose fail-closed policy this PR narrows.
